basic_info.description: Stately and semi-detached four-bedroom, two and a half bath updated center patio home with views and situated in a stellar Sunset/Parkside location! The timeless and tasteful facade sets the tenor for this home resplendent with period details and modern upgrades. The home opens to a formal living room with a fireplace, a grand dining room, a convenient breakfast area, an updated gourmet kitchen with high-end appliances, skylight, gorgeous wood floors and a center patio awash with natural light. There are two spacious bedrooms on this level with ocean views and an updated full bath and half bath. The lower level of the home presents a flexible floor plan with separate access, two additional bedrooms, a full bath, wet bar, and a living/dining area that opens to the backyard/garden/patio with mature landscaping. The large garage with plenty of storage space adds the finishing touches to the special home that is close to shopping, restaurants, cafes, playgrounds, parks, public transportation HWY 280 and more!
